Final candidate (NMSE 2.213e-3): forcing F0·cos(0.17t) + F1·sin(0.17t), plus a constant, linear x and v, ln v, x·v, cos v, sin v and x·v², with ω fixed at 0.17.

import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    a0,a1,a2,a3,a4,a5,a6,a7,a8,a9 = params
    w = 0.17
    F = a0*np.cos(w*t) + a1*np.sin(w*t)
    return F + a2 + a3*x + a4*v + a5*np.log(v) + a6*x*v + a7*np.cos(v) + a8*np.sin(v) + a9*x*v**2
